title: 36th Infantry Division Celebrates 100th Anniversary B-Roll
description: The 36th Infantry Division began its 100th anniversary celebration with a march along Congress Ave to the Texas Capitol on July16, 2017.  The celebration continued at the 36th Infantry Division Monument on the Texas Capitol grounds with a wreath laying ceremony honoring past Soldiers’ sacrifices.  The division’s last 100 years includes fighting in World War I, World War II, the Global War on Terror, and other peacekeeping missions around the world.  The division also supports the home front fighting wild fires, flood relief rescues, disaster relief and border security operations.
